Class LessonsModelTestingAutomation

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.LessonsModelTestingAutomation
public class LessonsModelTestingAutomation extends Object

Title: LessonsModelTestingAutomation Class.

Description: Semi-automated tests for the Models of the three Contributor GUI packages: ModelLessonsList, ModelLessonEditor, and ModelLessonDetail. Each Controller passes what the user typed or selected to its Model and displays what the Model returns, so these tests check the same decisions the windows make, without opening a window. What only a window can show (the confirmation dialog, disabled buttons, the status line on screen) is covered by the manual procedures in LessonsManualTestProcedures.

Requirements covered: CS-1 (create, contributor set from the logged in user), CS-2 (the list and its empty-state message), CS-4 (search and its no-match message), CS-5 (category filter and its no-match message), CS-6 (only my lessons), CS-7 (update), CS-8 (delete), and CS-9 (only the contributor may update or delete), CS-11 (empty keyword entries are kept so validation can refuse them), and the CS-5 rule that the filter's "All categories" label cannot be stored as a category.

The tests share one in-memory database and run in id order. MOD-01 stores a lesson for arushugal and a second lesson is stored for karanpatel before MOD-03; later tests use these two lessons.

Each test is one private method named after its id, whose Javadoc states the requirement, how the test exercises the code, and the condition for a Pass.

How to read the output: one "Pass:" or "Failure:" line per test id, then the suite totals.

    • mod01SaveNewLesson

      private static void mod01SaveNewLesson()

      MOD-01 (CS-1, positive). The editor stores a new lesson and records the logged in user as its contributor.

      How: ModelLessonEditor.saveNewLesson is called with "arushugal" as the logged in user, which is how ControllerLessonEditor calls it. The editor has no contributor field, so this is the only way the contributor can be set.

      Pass when: saveNewLesson returns null, the stored list grows by one, and the stored lesson's contributor is "arushugal".

    • mod02SaveNewLessonBlankTitle

      private static void mod02SaveNewLessonBlankTitle()

      MOD-02 (CS-1, negative). The editor refuses a lesson with a blank title and stores nothing.

      How: saveNewLesson is called with a title of "".

      Pass when: the problem is "The title is required" and the stored list is unchanged.

    • mod03NoFiltersShowsAll

      private static void mod03NoFiltersShowsAll()

      MOD-03 (CS-2, positive). With no search term, all categories, and "only mine" unticked, the page shows every lesson. An empty search box means "no search" on the page.

      How: refreshShownLessons("", ALL_CATEGORIES, false, "arushugal").

      Pass when: both stored lessons are shown and the status line reads "Showing 2 of 2 lessons.".

    • mod19MessageWhenNoLessonsStored

      private static void mod19MessageWhenNoLessonsStored()

      MOD-19 (CS-2, negative). When no lesson is stored at all, the status line says so in words instead of leaving a blank list.

      How: statusMessage(0, 0, "", ALL_CATEGORIES, false).

      Pass when: the message is "No lessons have been recorded yet. Press New Lesson to record the first one.".

    • mod05Search

      How: refreshShownLessons("JDBC", ...). Only the H2 lesson has JDBC as a keyword.

      Pass when: exactly one lesson is shown and it is the H2 lesson.

    • mod11OwnerMayChange

      private static void mod11OwnerMayChange()

      MOD-11 (CS-9, positive). The detail page lets the contributor edit and delete.

      How: ModelLessonDetail.canChange(H2 lesson, "arushugal"), the call ViewLessonDetail uses to enable the Edit and Delete buttons.

      Pass when: canChange returns true and the ownership note says the user can edit or delete.

    • mod12NonOwnerMayNotChange

      private static void mod12NonOwnerMayNotChange()

      MOD-12 (CS-9, negative). The detail page does not let anyone else edit or delete, and says whose lesson it is.

      How: canChange(H2 lesson, "karanpatel").

      Pass when: canChange returns false and the ownership note names arushugal as the contributor.

    • mod20NonOwnerEdit

      private static void mod20NonOwnerEdit()

      MOD-20 (CS-9, negative). The editor refuses changes from anyone but the contributor, even though the page never offers them Edit, and the stored lesson is not changed.

      How: ModelLessonEditor.saveChanges is called on karanpatel's JavaFX lesson with "arushugal" as the logged in user and a new title.

      Pass when: the problem is "Only the contributor can change this lesson" and the stored title is unchanged.

    • mod21LeadingEmptyKeywordRefused

      private static void mod21LeadingEmptyKeywordRefused()

      MOD-21 (CS-11, negative). The editor keeps a leading empty keyword, so validation refuses it instead of the editor silently changing what the contributor typed.

      How: tidyKeywords(", java") is called the way ModelLessonEditor does before saving, and the result is passed to LessonInputPolicy.validateKeywords. Before the fix the editor returned "java" and the lesson was accepted.

      Pass when: the tidied text is ", java" and the problem is "A keyword is empty".

    • mod22TrailingEmptyKeywordRefused

      private static void mod22TrailingEmptyKeywordRefused()

      MOD-22 (CS-11, negative). A trailing comma is an empty keyword and is refused.

      How: tidyKeywords("java,") gives "java, ", which validateKeywords splits with a negative limit so the trailing empty entry is kept. Before the fix, split(",") dropped it and a direct call accepted "java,".

      Pass when: the tidied text is "java, " and the problem is "A keyword is empty".

    • mod23ReservedCategoryRefused

      private static void mod23ReservedCategoryRefused()

      MOD-23 (CS-5, negative). The editor refuses the list page's "All categories" label as a real category, because a lesson stored under it could never be filtered on its own.

      How: saveNewLesson is called with ModelLessonsList.ALL_CATEGORIES as the category.

      Pass when: the problem is "The category name is reserved" and no lesson with the test title was stored.

    • mod24SimilarCategoryNamesAccepted

      private static void mod24SimilarCategoryNamesAccepted()

      MOD-24 (CS-5, positive). Names that only resemble the reserved label are still accepted, and a lesson stored under one can be filtered on its own.

      How: validateCategory is called with "All", "Categories", and "All categories list"; then a lesson is saved under "All" and the page is filtered by "All".

      Pass when: all three names are accepted, the save returns null, and filtering by "All" shows exactly that one lesson.

    • mod13OwnerUpdate

      private static void mod13OwnerUpdate()

      MOD-13 (CS-7, positive). The contributor's change to the title is stored.

      How: saveChanges is called on the H2 lesson as "arushugal" with a new title; the lesson is then read again from the database.

      Pass when: saveChanges returns null and the stored title is the new one.

    • mod14UpdateBlankDescription

      private static void mod14UpdateBlankDescription()

      MOD-14 (CS-7, negative). A change that empties the description is refused, because an edit is validated the same way as a new lesson.

      How: saveChanges is called on the updated H2 lesson as "arushugal" with a description of "".

      Pass when: the problem is "The description is required" and the stored description is unchanged.

    • mod15OwnerDelete

      private static void mod15OwnerDelete()

      MOD-15 (CS-8, positive). The contributor deletes the lesson, and it is gone from both the database and the shared list every page reads.

      How: ModelLessonDetail.deleteLesson is called on the H2 lesson as "arushugal". The Controller asks for confirmation first; that dialog is checked by MAN-04.

      Pass when: deleteLesson returns null, reading the id returns null, and the shared list no longer holds it.

    • mod16NonOwnerDelete

      private static void mod16NonOwnerDelete()

      MOD-16 (CS-8 and CS-9, negative). A delete by someone other than the contributor is refused and the lesson stays stored.

      How: deleteLesson is called on karanpatel's JavaFX lesson as "arushugal".

      Pass when: the problem is "Only the contributor can delete this lesson" and the lesson can still be read.
